rules.rule: valid_until > valid_from; timestamps UTC aware; now from trusted clock
approval principal/subject/scope/revoke/expiry checked by broker; schema only enforces nonnull shape
applied requires independent artifact checks, same memory revision, run and request binding
end >= start only same boot clock; missing start pending/unknown; never clamp negatives
dedupe physical_attempt_id; retry_of chain matches same logical request; parent must exist or explicit orphan
all plan/patch/eval/review/approval/release digests agree with canonical objects and scope
promotion alone does not satisfy 3-4; next_run binding and actual context/tool application evidence required
canonical tombstone blocks every new query even if projection lagged
design extension, not applied migration; compile all three target DDL in order; no schema overwrite
